function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the HyperFund and HyperVerse alleged cryptocurrency fraud network comprehensively, using only benchmark-returned evidence and preserving every source identifier exactly. Cover: (1) alleged Ponzi or pyramid mechanics, membership tiers, deposits, promised returns, payment or withdrawal structures, recruitment commissions and incentives, and any documented or alleged fund flows; (2) public promoters, influencers, executives, speakers, endorsers, corporate entities, and other affiliates, stating exactly what each source supports and separating verified actions or statements from allegations, inference, or uncertainty; (3) a dated chronology of names and rebranding, including HyperFund, HyperVerse, HyperNation, HyperCommunity, HyperTech or any other tool-supported names, and explain whether evidence supports continuity, expansion, or merely an asserted connection; and (4) the purported chief executive and other senior figures, including names, biographies, public personas, identities, roles, and evidence that supports, disputes, or leaves uncertain those claims. Highlight contradictions and evidentiary gaps, distinguish legal/regulatory allegations from adjudicated facts, and map relationships only when directly supported. Return a structured synthesis with source IDs attached to each material fact or claim; do not fill gaps from general knowledge or unstated assumptions."}
function.name: ConductResearch
